title: The Gnumu Settlement
description: The principal Gnumu settlement has an Elder Shaman prepared to receive you. Establish formal contact with the local polity without assuming what place it will ultimately occupy in your reign.
description_completed: Formal contact has been established with the designated Gnumu settlement. Its political outcome remains unresolved.

dialogue.offer: You are the one from the dark tower. If you have business with this settlement, speak it here. I will hear what kind of ruler has returned to the world.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: Good. We understand one another well enough to begin. The settlement now knows who has come to its door.
dialogue.completed: The Elder Shaman remembers your coming. Whatever follows between us will not be by accident.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign

rewards.name: Record formal contact with the designated Gnumu settlement
